from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RegionStats(BaseModel):
    region_name: str = Field(description="Name of the region (e.g., West, South, Midwest, Northeast)")
    housing_starts_volume: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate housing starts for this region in the target month")
    growth_rate: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-month percent change for this region in the target month")

class ConstructionReport(BaseModel):
    release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released, used for precedence rules")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The specific month the data represents, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    regions: list[RegionStats] = Field(description="List of regional statistics contained in this report for the data_month")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[ConstructionReport]
